headline: High risk of data leakage and cascading errors: Aci can egress broadly into CRM/email while OpenBBTerminal consumes MCP/REST inputs with no documented verification or isolation.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Aci can ingest and emit content through MCP and email/Slack/CRM surfaces, while OpenBBTerminal can consume MCP servers and stdin/stdout. That creates a plausible instruction-smuggling path if Aci forwards untrusted text into OpenBB inputs. The profiles do not document provenance checks or sanitization, so uncertainty pushes above low.
conditions: IF Aci forwards untrusted CRM/email/Slack text into OpenBBTerminal via MCP or stdin/stdout
IF OpenBBTerminal parses that content as instructions without provenance checks
mitigations: Add a fixed allowlist for OpenBBTerminal inputs before forwarding
Strip imperative phrases from Aci-generated text before handoff
Use a human approval step for any MCP payload crossing agents
requires-engineering: add provenance tags end-to-end

B_data_leakage.rationale: Aci touches CRM, email, calendar, support, and research data and has broad network egress plus API integrations. OpenBBTerminal touches financial and licensed data and can connect to MCP/REST endpoints. If Aci passes sensitive records into OpenBBTerminal or vice versa, the pair can leak regulated or confidential data across systems by default pathways.
conditions: IF Aci sends CRM/email/calendar content into OpenBBTerminal
IF OpenBBTerminal returns financial outputs that Aci republishes into email, Slack, or CRM
mitigations: Disable forwarding of raw customer records between agents
Redact identifiers before any MCP handoff
Restrict Aci egress destinations to approved domains
Log and review all cross-agent payloads for sensitive fields
requires-engineering: enforce data-class policy at the orchestrator

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents support multiple instances, and Aci has broad network egress while OpenBBTerminal can use MCP and REST APIs. Even though OpenBBTerminal cannot write files or modify git, they can still contend over shared mutable external resources such as APIs, OAuth-backed services, or localhost endpoints. The overlap is real but narrower than filesystem conflict.
conditions: IF both agents are configured against the same OAuth-backed CRM, calendar, or finance API
IF both issue concurrent writes or stateful queries to the same external service
mitigations: Serialize writes through one orchestrator queue
Assign separate service accounts per agent
Disable concurrent mutation on shared APIs
Use optimistic-lock retries for stateful endpoints
requires-engineering: add resource-level locking

D_cascading_error.rationale: Aci can generate CRM/email/calendar actions and OpenBBTerminal can consume MCP/REST inputs, so Aci’s outputs may become OpenBBTerminal’s inputs without a documented verification layer. That creates a plausible cascade where one agent’s mistaken facts are amplified into downstream analysis or actions. The profiles do not show explicit critical evaluation, so uncertainty stays above low.
conditions: IF OpenBBTerminal consumes Aci-produced summaries as authoritative inputs
IF no human or programmatic verification step checks Aci outputs before downstream use
mitigations: Require source links on every Aci summary
Add a verification checklist before OpenBBTerminal consumes Aci output
Compare key fields against original records before acting
Route high-impact actions to manual approval
requires-engineering: implement confidence and provenance gating

E_compliance.rationale: Aci handles customer support, email, CRM, and calendar data, while OpenBBTerminal handles financial and licensed data. If EU personal data or regulated customer records flow from Aci into OpenBBTerminal’s finance workflows, residency and retention obligations can be breached. No DPA, residency, or retention controls are documented in either profile, so the safer severity is high.
conditions: IF EU personal data from Aci is processed by OpenBBTerminal without a DPA
IF regulated customer or financial records are retained under mismatched policies
mitigations: Block transfer of personal data into finance workflows
Classify data before any cross-agent exchange
Set retention timers for shared artifacts
Review vendor DPAs and residency terms
requires-engineering: enforce policy-based routing by data class
